problem: The garden gave 86 tomatoes on Sunday. Mrs. Bello packs them into boxes of 9 for the market and gives the extra tomatoes to her neighbour. The neighbour has a big dog. How many tomatoes does the neighbour get?
follow_up_questions: Each box costs 7 dollars at the market. How much will the boxes bring in if they all sell?
By the end of the day, 2 boxes are still unsold. How much money did she take?

problem: How many cookies do the teachers get? A school bakes 86 cookies, puts them in tins of 9 for the fair, and gives the cookies that do not fill a tin to the teachers. The oven was very old.
follow_up_questions: Each tin sells for 7 dollars. How much will the tins raise if they all sell?
At closing time, 2 tins are left. How much money did the fair take from the tins?

problem: The zoo has 2 giraffes. On Friday, a keeper leads 30 goats into the barn in groups of 4. How many goats are left over after all the full groups are inside?
follow_up_questions: Each full group takes 5 minutes to get inside. How long do the full groups take?

problem: How many children are left over when 30 children cross the road in groups of 4 with a teacher? The school has 9 classrooms.
follow_up_questions: Every full group takes 5 minutes to cross. How many minutes do the full groups take?

problem: Each day a juice stand squeezes 84 cups of orange juice and pours it into jugs that hold 12 cups. The stand has a striped roof. How many jugs are filled each day?
follow_up_questions: How many jugs are filled over a week?

problem: How many crates do the hens' 84 eggs fill each day if a crate takes 12 eggs? The rooster crows loudly.
follow_up_questions: Over a week, how many crates are filled?

problem: A builder needs 75 planks for a new shed. His van can carry 11 planks per trip. How many trips must the van make?
follow_up_questions: Each trip uses 3 litres of fuel. How much fuel does the van use altogether?

problem: How many trips does a boat need to take 75 tourists to the island if it carries 11 people a trip?
follow_up_questions: The boat burns 3 litres of fuel on each trip. How many litres does it burn in all?

problem: The bakery cat is 9 years old. On Monday, Jo bakes 35 rolls and packs them in bags of 8. How many rolls do not fit in a full bag?
follow_up_questions: She eats the leftover rolls and sells each full bag for 3 dollars. How much money does she make?
She buys a pot of honey with 7 dollars of that money. How much does she have left?
On Tuesday she earns the same amount from her bags again. How much money does she have now?

problem: How many pencils are left over when Ken packs 35 pencils into boxes of 8? His school has 4 floors.
follow_up_questions: He keeps the leftover pencils and sells each full box for 3 dollars. How much does he earn?
He then spends 7 dollars of it on a ruler set. How much money remains?
The next week he earns the same amount from boxes again. How much money does he have now?

problem: A toy shop has 54 dolls and 27 teddy bears to put on show, with 9 toys on each shelf. What is the number of shelves used?
How many tables of 9 are needed for 54 parents and 27 grandparents at the school concert?
The pool opens at 7 every day. Towel bins each hold 15 towels, and on Monday 90 towels were left in the changing rooms. How many bins can be filled?
follow_up_questions: A worker washes one bin of towels in 20 minutes. How many minutes will all the bins take?
If two workers split the washing equally, how many minutes does each one work?

problem: How many boxes can be filled with 90 apples if a box holds 15 apples? The farm shop has 3 tills.
follow_up_questions: Packing one box takes 20 minutes. How many minutes of packing is that?
Two packers share the work equally. How many minutes does each packer work?

problem: At the science fair, 58 children want to try the telescope. Only 7 children can stand around it at once. How many turns must the teacher plan for?
How many pottery classes must be held so that 58 adults can each take one, if a class has room for 7?
Gita has 39 logs to carry to the campfire. She carries 5 logs each trip. On her final trip, how many logs does she carry?
How many boxes are in the last load if 39 boxes are moved onto a truck 5 at a time?
There are 25 children at the art workshop. Each paint set is shared by 3 children. How many paint sets are needed so no child is left out?
How many tents are needed for 25 scouts if each tent sleeps 3?
A swimming club plans lessons for beginners. In all, 68 children signed up, and each lesson can take 15 children. How many lessons should be planned?
follow_up_questions: Each lesson needs 2 coaches. How many coaches are needed?
Only 7 coaches have signed up so far. How many more are needed?
Each coach will get 4 free passes as a thank-you. How many passes does the club need?

problem: How many tours of the castle must a guide run so that all 68 visitors get one, if each tour takes 15 people?
follow_up_questions: Every tour needs 2 guides. How many guides are needed?
Only 7 guides are working today. How many guides short are they?
Each guide gets 4 meal tickets. How many meal tickets are needed?

problem: A chess club has 32 members, and they play in groups of 4. Find how many groups they make.
follow_up_questions: Each group plays 3 games a week. How many games does the club play in a week?
The club's goal is 50 games. After that week, how many games are left to play?

problem: How many tables do 32 card players fill if they sit 4 to a table?
follow_up_questions: At each table, 3 games are played every week. How many games is that in a week?
The tournament needs 50 games. How many more games must be played after that week?

problem: Pencils are tied in bundles of 10 for the school shop. There are 70 red pencils and 26 blue pencils to bundle. How many full bundles can be made?
follow_up_questions: How many pencils are not in a full bundle?
Each full bundle sells for 5 dollars. How much money will the bundles raise?

problem: How many full boxes of 10 can a farmer pack from 70 brown eggs and 26 white eggs?
follow_up_questions: How many eggs are left out of the full boxes?
A full box sells for 5 dollars. What do the boxes earn?

problem: The school trip leaves at 8. Each of the 64 pupils needs a sandwich, and sandwiches come in trays of 6. How many trays should the school order?
follow_up_questions: Once every pupil has a sandwich, how many sandwiches are left on the trays?
Each tray costs 5 dollars. What is the cost of the trays?

problem: How many packs of 6 medals must the club buy so each of its 64 runners gets one? The race is 3 miles long.
follow_up_questions: After every runner gets a medal, how many medals are spare?
A pack costs 5 dollars. How much do the packs cost?

problem: After art class, the teacher collects 23 paintbrushes. A jar holds 5 brushes. How many jars does she need for all the brushes?
follow_up_questions: She can carry 2 jars at a time. How many trips to the sink must she make?

problem: How many baskets are needed to carry 23 pumpkins if a basket holds 5?
follow_up_questions: Uncle Taro carries 2 baskets on each trip. How many trips does he make?

problem: A camp has 90 tent pegs. Each tent uses 8 pegs. Once the leaders put up as many tents as they can, how many pegs are left in the bag?
follow_up_questions: Each tent sleeps 6 campers. How many campers can sleep in the tents?
The camp has 70 campers. How many campers have no tent?

problem: How many sticks of chalk are left when a teacher puts 8 sticks in each box, filling as many boxes as she can from 90 sticks?
follow_up_questions: Each box is shared by 6 pupils. How many pupils get chalk?
The school has 70 pupils. How many pupils do not get chalk?

problem: Parents drive the choir to a concert in town. Each car can take 4 singers, and 18 singers are going. What is the smallest number of cars needed?
follow_up_questions: How many empty singer seats will there be in the cars?
Each car uses 3 litres of fuel for the trip. How many litres do all the cars use?

problem: How many canoes are needed for 18 campers if each canoe holds 4?
follow_up_questions: How many empty places will there be in the canoes?
Each canoe carries 3 water bottles. How many water bottles are in the canoes?

problem: For a party, Mr. Ali needs 30 slices of pizza. He cuts each pizza into 4 slices. How many pizzas must he cut?
follow_up_questions: How many pizza slices will be left over?
Frozen pizzas come in packs of 5. How many packs does he buy?

problem: How many apples must a cook cut to get 30 apple wedges if every apple gives 4 wedges?
follow_up_questions: How many wedges will be extra?
Apples are sold in bags of 5. How many bags does the cook buy?

problem: Mr. Reyes has 45 minutes for science experiments on Wednesday. Each experiment takes 5 minutes. How many experiments can he fit in?
follow_up_questions: He does 4 of them before the lunch bell. How many experiments come after lunch?
Each experiment after lunch uses 6 cups. How many cups does he need for those experiments?
He has 34 cups. Find how many cups are not needed.

problem: How many songs can a band play in a 45 minute show if each song lasts 5 minutes?
follow_up_questions: They play 4 songs before the break. How many songs come after the break?
During each song after the break, 6 balloons drop from the ceiling. How many balloons are needed?
The band bought 34 balloons. How many balloons are spare?

problem: A dishwasher holds 6 trays in one load, and the café has 27 trays to wash. The café owner likes everything to shine. After all the full loads, how many trays are left for the last wash?
follow_up_questions: Each full load takes 40 minutes. How many minutes do the full loads take?
The last small load takes 30 minutes. How long does all the washing take, in minutes?

problem: How many blankets are left for the final small load when 27 blankets are washed 6 at a time? The blankets came from the cabin.
follow_up_questions: A full load runs for 40 minutes. How long do all the full loads run, in minutes?
The final small load needs 30 minutes. How many minutes of washing is there altogether?

problem: Swim practice starts at 6. Mia swims 39 lengths in sets of 10. How many lengths are in her last set, which is shorter than the others?
How many cards are in the last pile if Jun deals 39 cards into piles of 10 and the last pile is smaller? He has 4 cousins.
Mona wants to read 40 poems. If she reads 5 poems every afternoon, after how many afternoons will she reach her goal?
How many days will it take Igor to save $40 if he puts away $5 each day?
The garden has 48 red tulips and 36 yellow tulips, all planted in rows of 12. How many rows of tulips are there?
How many shelves of 12 jars does a shop fill with 48 jars of jam and 36 jars of honey?
The swimming gala lasts 4 hours. There are 66 swimmers, and each relay team has 6 swimmers. How many teams are there?
follow_up_questions: The pool has room for 3 teams to race at once. How many races must be held so that every team swims once?

problem: How many groups of 6 can be made from the 66 children at the art camp? The camp lasts 2 weeks.
follow_up_questions: Each group gets a turn at the pottery wheels, and 3 groups can use them at the same time. How many turns must be planned so that every group has a go?

problem: Each taxi carries 7 guests from the hotel to the wedding. This Saturday, 16 guests need a ride. The hotel has a big fountain. How many taxis are needed?
follow_up_questions: Each taxi needs a driver, and 2 drivers are already waiting. How many more drivers are needed?

problem: How many boats are needed to take 16 fishermen out to sea if a boat holds 7? The sea was calm and blue.
follow_up_questions: Each boat needs one captain, and 2 captains are ready. How many more captains are needed?

problem: Before the school trip, a teacher packs 80 crackers into bags of 6, one bag for each pupil. Any crackers that do not fill a bag go to the helpers. How many crackers do the helpers get?
follow_up_questions: Only 12 pupils come on the trip. How many crackers are in the bags nobody takes?
Those crackers and the helpers' crackers are shared equally among the 4 helpers. How many crackers does each helper get?

problem: How many grapes go to the parents if a mum fills snack cups with 6 grapes each from 80 grapes, one cup per child, and gives the grapes that do not fill a cup to the parents?
follow_up_questions: Only 12 children come to the party. How many grapes are in the cups nobody takes?
Those grapes and the parents' grapes are shared equally by the 4 parents. How many grapes does each parent get?
